translation_notes: SDO.image -> sdo:image; the only RDF term in the region
the mechanical draft had inserted the 14 @prefix lines INSIDE the from rdflib.namespace import ( ... ) parenthesised list, which does not parse; the declarations were moved after the import block
only the prefix actually used (sdo:) is declared: a @prefix produces no runtime object, so it neither replaces nor duplicates the imports, and declaring the 13 unused ones would be noise
the import block is kept verbatim on both sides (it is extracted context: Graph, Literal and URIRef are still used in the signature and the isinstance test)
the read itself (graph.objects(...) plus an isinstance filter) stays plain Python: ldpy has no island for filtering reads, so only the predicate term benefits
driver: two fixtures, one where the answer is a strict subset of the sdo:image objects (an IRI-valued image must be filtered out) and one where the subject has no image
